founder.bio:
Julie brings over 10 years of experience across accounting, tax, finance and business. She spent six years at public accounting firms, including RSM, before founding Fiducia Tax & Financial Solutions in 2020.

Her approach is simple: put clients' goals first, explain things clearly, and deliver results you can rely on.
credentials: B.S. Economics & Accounting — University of Maryland, College Park
